assessment.public_access: Public URLs and robots access observations do not establish reuse permission.
assessment.storage: Copying original expression can engage reproduction rights. Short length alone does not settle originality, quotation purpose or database extraction.
assessment.local_inference: Local Ollama limits external disclosure; it does not itself grant copying or reuse rights. No model training is proposed.
assessment.answers: Attribution is necessary for relevant quotation uses but not sufficient alone to establish that arbitrary full-paragraph answer reproduction qualifies.
assessment.public_github: Publishing code and reference URLs is distinct from publishing source excerpts. Keep catalog and private review records excluded.
assessment.privacy: Retained excerpt screening and owner review are separate from copyright. No whole-page personal-data clearance is inferred.
assessment.public_documents: A municipal decision may be exempt, but all eight service-page passages have not been individually established as exempt public-authority documents.
assessment.facts: Independently expressed bare facts and reference links offer a narrower route; do not copy protected expression or make unsupported freshness claims.

alternative.mode: Explicit link-only navigation, not automatic fallback. Eight reference URLs and project-authored topic labels; no catalog, excerpt copying, retrieval, model call, current-fact answer or approval assertion.
alternative.limitations: Does not satisfy renewed real-source AI demonstration. A fact-answer mode would need separately reviewed fact-only inputs and verification policy; not implemented by relabelling existing verbatim excerpts.

required_resolution: Provide a source-specific applicable licence/permission or a documented legal assessment covering storage, local inference and the intended quotation/display scope. Do not set source_permission_verified true solely from ownership of the student software.
